# The Canada Guide

> > A comprehensive educational resource covering Canadian history, government, geography, demographics, and culture from Confederation to the modern era.

The Canada Guide provides detailed information about Canada's prime ministers, provinces and territories, Indigenous peoples, economic development, foreign policy, and national identity. It serves as an authoritative reference for understanding Canadian history, political evolution from British Empire to independence, and contemporary demographics.

## Key Topics

- Canadian History
- Prime Ministers
- Quebec
- Indigenous Peoples & First Nations
- British Empire & Canadian Independence
- Conservative Party
- Demographics & Population Statistics
- Canadian Geography & Provinces
- Military History & World War I
- Free Trade & Economic Policy
- Brian Mulroney Era
- Atlantic Canada
- Ontario & Ottawa
- Foreign Policy & International Relations

## Getting Started

- [Basics](https://thecanadaguide.com/basics): Essential introduction to Canada: people, language, demographics & facts
- [Indigenous Peoples](https://thecanadaguide.com/basics/aboriginals): Overview of Indigenous Peoples, First Nations & Aboriginal history
- [Economy](https://thecanadaguide.com/basics/the-economy): Economic history from fur trade to modern Canadian industries
- [Foreign Policy](https://thecanadaguide.com/basics/foreign-policy): Canadian foreign policy, UN, NATO & post-British Empire relations

## Data & Statistics

- [Data](https://thecanadaguide.com/data): Reference section with chronological Canadian history & government data
- [Population](https://thecanadaguide.com/data/population): Population statistics for provinces, cities & census data
- [Wars](https://thecanadaguide.com/data/wars): Military history statistics: Canadian wars, casualties & conflicts

## Prime Ministers

- [Wilfrid Laurier](https://thecanadaguide.com/history/prime-ministers/wilfrid-laurier): Profile of PM Wilfrid Laurier's nation-building & immigration era
- [Robert Borden](https://thecanadaguide.com/history/prime-ministers/robert-borden): Profile of PM Robert Borden's WWI leadership & independence push
- [Brian Mulroney](https://thecanadaguide.com/history/prime-ministers/brian-mulroney): Profile of PM Brian Mulroney covering free trade, GST & Reagan era
- [Mackenzie Bowell](https://thecanadaguide.com/history/prime-ministers/mackenzie-bowell): Profile of PM Mackenzie Bowell & Manitoba Schools Question era

## Regions & Tourism

- [Atlantic Canada](https://thecanadaguide.com/places/atlantic-canada): Guide to Atlantic provinces: Newfoundland, Nova Scotia, NB & PEI
- [The North](https://thecanadaguide.com/places/the-north): Guide to northern territories: Yukon, NWT, Nunavut & Arctic region
- [Ontario Tourism](https://thecanadaguide.com/places/canadian-tourism/ontario-tourism): Tourism guide to Ontario featuring Toronto, Ottawa & Lake Ontario

## Optional

- [Special Thanks](https://thecanadaguide.com/special-thanks): Acknowledgments for Kickstarter backers and project supporters
